title: Dracula Merchandise, 100 Days Of Trump, and the Most Comfortable Sheets
content:
:emoji:‍♂️ "I Have Dracula Merchandise" – A Delightfully Nerdy Film
Caleb is trapped in a video game, due to accidently getting caught up in a demonic spell (hey it happens). Can Frankie help him escape before the game timer ends? Possibly, with the help of a of song, Dracula merchandise, and assorted memes, in this charming animated short from CalArts film student Ben Knight. Posted by cortex on MetaFilter.

"Documenting the Damage" – 100 Alarms, 100 days: Trump's Second Term Blitz Brett Heinz catalogs 100 harmful policies enacted during the first 100 days of Trump's second term, drawing a picture of rapid and radical transformation. Posted by subdee on MetaFilter.

️ "The Most Comfortable Sheets in the World" – Are They Worth It? A simple but important question, especially after the previous post! This AskMetaFilter thread has real answers from real people, with the goal of helping you have the best sleep ever, and covers a range of options price-wise. Posted in AskMetaFilter by leafmealone.
author: Brandon Blatcher
